description: A manifest has to reach the Yards Freight Office with its seal unbroken. The Trade Office will hand it over and won't say what it lists.
name: Manifest

objectives.desc: Collect the sealed manifest at the Halcyon Trade Office counter.
emotes: {who} is handed a manifest in a wax-sealed sleeve and asked to sign for the seal, not the contents.

objectives.desc: Deliver it to the Yards Freight Office.
emotes: {who} hands over a sealed manifest. The clerk checks the wax and not the paper.
